definitions.explanation: Something that provokes a physical or mental response.
Something that encourages action or effort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{刺激|しげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脳|のう}→脳：03537_nou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刺激|しげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Coffee provides stimulation to the brain.

notes:
{刺激|しげき} refers to anything that provokes a response, whether physical (sensory stimulation) or psychological (motivation, inspiration).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {刺激|しげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to give/provide stimulation)
- {刺激|しげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive stimulation)
- {刺激|しげき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to serve as stimulation)
- {刺激|しげき}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be stimulated/inspired)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{刺激|しげき} (strong stimulation)
- ⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{刺激|しげき} (good stimulation)
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{刺激|しげき}⟦{策|さく}→策：noentry⟧ (economic stimulus measures)

USAGE:
As a suru-verb, {刺激|しげき}する means "to stimulate" (transitive). The passive form {刺激|しげき}される often means "to be inspired" when referring to motivation.
